title: Doggol e nder maayo ngo alaa deeƴre
intro: Natal ina darii e dow ŋoral laana njoorndi, nde ɓuuɓol ngol ina ɓuuɓtoo, yimɓe ɓee ina mbaɗa loowdi ngam ustude jolɗe ɗee. Limre wootere ina yahra yeeso, ina jaɓa baasal nanndungal e joofnirde, tan ko luggiɗde wonta nokku juulde e hootde. Caggal fenaande ina woodi renndo jeertinaango e jukkungo garoowo, yeeso ina woodi yurmeende nde sikkaano.
clues: Mi neldaama nulaaɗo e ko ɓuri teemedere ujunere neɗɗo.
Mi acci leñol am e tikkere hade am heɓde yamiroore yahde.
Mi naati e laana njoorndi, gollotooɓe e laana kaa mbaɗi loowdi ngam ƴeewde hol mo werletee e laana.
Mi werlaa e maayo, liɗɗi mawɗi muɗi mi, tawi miɗo wondi e aybinde.
Mi teddinii Alla e nder ni66e, mi anndinii wonde alaa laamcfo so wonaa kanko, mi jeyaa ko e tooñ6e.
Mi werlaa e daande maayo udditiingo, mi ñawɗo, Alla waɗi lekki ɓuuɓki e dow am, ndeen leñol am ngoongɗini, rokkaama weltaare haa juuti.

trial.label: Hol Ñaawoore nde njogori-mi?
options: Wertaa e yiite waɗaaɗo cooyɗo e kisal
Muuɗi liɗɗi mawɗi ɗii caggal nde ndogi
Werlo e nder ɓunndu luggiɗndu e banndiraaɓe jeertinɓe
Fiyi e rafi juutɗo e ŋakkeende cellal
Yamiraama yo sakko ɓiɗɗo jiɗaaɗo
trial.answer: Muuɗi liɗɗi mawɗi ɗii caggal nde ndogi

location.answer: Liingu mawngu nguu e reedu mum

outcome.label: Hol ko wonnoo batte am?
options: Hisnaama e teddungal e leñol am ngoongɗini, kisnaama haa wakkati
Leñol am waylitiima wonti mborosaaji ngam bonnude ñalngu sabaabu
Yimɓe am leydi muɗi ɗum ngam mawnikinaare
Leñol am nanngaama e ɓuuɓol mawngol ummoraade e asamaan
Yimɓe am njippiima e ilam mawɗam
outcome.answer: Hisnaama e teddungal e leñol am ngoongɗini, kisnaama haa wakkati

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
